messages:
Rhea Patel: Heads-up: AuroraGoods dropped ~65% in token usage over last 10 days. Renewal in ~5 weeks. Procurement contact changed to M. Dwyer and they mentioned running a short competitor bakeoff. Can we triage? :warning:
Samir Gupta: Do we see which features dipped (embeds vs gen vs rerank)? Any billing/SSO events?
Rhea Patel: Mainly rerank and embeddings. Generation steady. No billing flags. Seats logged in but low traffic.
Evan Lee: I'll check infra traces and prefix/cache stats.
Clara Vos: Recommend quick "rampback" enablement: 20m with their ML infra + product to run through batching + embed cache tips. I can prep a one-pager.
Samir Gupta: I'll reach out to M. Dwyer for a 30m slot and offer a short trial-extension if they agree to the tech sync.
Evan Lee: infra quick dump:
```
route: /v1/embeddings
window: 72h
avg-latency: 200ms
vector-cache-hit: 9% (baseline ~60%)
5xx: 0.0%
```
Evan Lee: Low cache hit suggests client-side key changes or a new ingestion job. Found user-agent: aurora-ingest/3.0.0.
Rhea Patel: Could that SDK bump be the cause? They recently upgraded per our onboarding notes.
Evan Lee: Likely. I can push an org-scoped compatibility shim to accept the new header for 48h while we advise rollback.
Clara Vos: I'll include the rollback snippet in the one-pager and dashboard tiles to watch.
RenewalBot: RENEWAL ALERT: 36 days out. Risk elevated (usage down + procurement change + competitor trial). Suggested actions: enablement + org-scoped patch + commercial nudge.
Samir Gupta: Owners: Rhea (CS), Samir (AM), Evan (tech), Clara (enablement). Milestones:
- Today EOD: Evan to deploy shim to org:aurora (ts 4312345700)
- 24h: Clara to send one-pager and calendar invite (ts 4312345900)
- 48h: Samir to confirm competitor and propose extension if needed (ts 4312346500)
Rhea Patel: If cache-hit >40% in 48h, downgrade risk. Otherwise escalate to solutions eng.
Samir Gupta: Sounds good. I'll keep messaging concise.
Evan Lee: Shim deployed to org:aurora. Monitoring now. :rocket:
